chunks: Al-Faḍl ibn ʿUthmān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said: He said:
“There is no obligation upon the people of the qiblah except sighting, and there is no obligation upon the Muslims except sighting.”

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْقِبْلَةِ: the people who face the qiblah, meaning the Muslim community
key_terms.الرُّؤْيَةُ: the sighting of the crescent moon as the legal basis here
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims addressed by this ruling

ai.seo_question: Is the beginning and ending of the fasting month based on moon sighting in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the basis for beginning or ending the fast is the actual sighting of the moon. It emphasizes that the duty binding the Muslim community in this matter is ruʾyah, that is, visual sighting.
